title: DeepID-Net: Deformable Deep Convolutional Neural Networks for Object Detection

problem.summary: Pretrained on object-level annoation In this paper, we propose deformable deep convolutional neural networks for generic object detection.
statements: Pretrained on object-level annoation In this paper, we propose deformable deep convolutional neural networks for generic object detection.
This new deep learning object detection framework has innovations in multiple aspects.
In the proposed new deep architecture, a new deformation constrained pooling (def-pooling) layer models the deformation of object parts with geometric constraint and penalty.
